Callout.Name: Secure Site - Perimeter Breach
Callout.Message: Perimeter alarm at a secure site, no visual.
Callout.Advisory: Camera offline at the breach point.

Script.Line: The alarm went and I was there in ninety seconds.
There is one footprint under the fence and nothing else.
The camera has been down two days and I have reported it twice.

Lines.Approach: The alarm is on the north fence and the camera covering it has been down two days.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
